findings.evidence: Line 221 `(hU : ∀ U : OpenSubgroup G, (U : Subgroup G).Normal → (U : Subgroup G).index = p → …)` vs line 350 `∀ U : OpenSubgroup G, (U : Subgroup G).Normal → …`; `grep -rn "isDemushkin_of_finrank_cohomFp_two_openSubgroup\|isDemushkin_of_topologicalGeneratorRankNat_openSubgroup" code` returns hits only in Recognition.lean (32, 35, 62, 64, 219, 289, 296, 335, 375). Precedent for the bare suffix meaning "all open subgroups": Demushkin/OpenSubgroup.lean:112 `theorem finrank_cohomFp_two_openSubgroup` for an arbitrary open `U`.
findings.fix: Keep the new convention (it matches `IsDemushkin.finrank_cohomFp_two_openSubgroup`, which is over all open subgroups) and rename the two older theorems to `isDemushkin_of_finrank_cohomFp_two_openSubgroup_index_eq` and `isDemushkin_of_topologicalGeneratorRankNat_openSubgroup_index_eq`, updating the module docstring (lines 32, 35, 62, 64) and the three in-file uses (lines 296, 335, 375). They are used nowhere else in the repo.
findings.issue: After this PR the suffix `_openSubgroup` denotes two different quantifier ranges in one file: `CohomologicalDimensionLE.isDemushkin_of_finrank_cohomFp_two_openSubgroup` (line 219) and `isDemushkin_of_topologicalGeneratorRankNat_openSubgroup` (line 289) quantify over open normal `U` with `(U : Subgroup G).index = p`, while the new `isDemushkin_iff_finrank_cohomFp_two_openSubgroup` (line 348) and `isDemushkin_iff_topologicalGeneratorRankNat_openSubgroup` (line 388) quantify over all open normal `U`, with the index-`p` versions carrying `_index_eq`. A consumer reading the `of`/`iff` pair as the same condition plus a converse picks the wrong scope.

summary: The new `_iff` names are accurate and the `_index_eq` suffix has in-repo precedent, but it now collides with the bare `openSubgroup` suffix of the two pre-existing `_of_` recognition theorems in the same file, which quantify over index-`p` subgroups only. Rename those two so the suffix means one thing.
